radius.$description: dimension used by the tooltip component for radius (MarsUI Tooltip master 12089:7621 List_wrap: Radius/big_component/radius_xs 16px).

padding-inline.$description: dimension used by the tooltip component for padding inline (MarsUI card padding Space/xl 12px on all sides).

padding-block.$description: dimension used by the tooltip component for padding block (MarsUI card padding Space/xl 12px on all sides).

max-inline-size.$description: dimension used by the tooltip component for max inline size (288px; the master card is fixed 280px wide in its rich variants — the 8px divergence is a documented text-only reduction).

offset.$description: dimension used by the tooltip component for offset (MarsUI caret depth 8px with zero extra gap = trigger-to-card distance).

arrow-size.$description: dimension used by the tooltip component for the depth of the arrow that points at the trigger; it is twice as wide (Tooltip master 12089:7621 pointer: 16x8). Zero removes it. Equal to offset, so the tip meets the trigger.

arrow-radius.$description: dimension used by the tooltip component for the rounding of the arrow tip (Tooltip master pointer: 1.5px, nearest radius step).

bg.$description: Base background color of the tooltip. Onmars v1 used a transparent backing beneath its translucent image.

border-width.$description: dimension used by the tooltip component for the outline width (MarsUI card 1px Outline/secondary_button_top stroke; replaces the 1px literal ki-tooltip.css shipped while the token was pending).

border-color.$description: color used by the tooltip component for its edge (MarsUI hairline, Outline/secondary_button_top); one token so a mode or a theme can strengthen it.

bg-image.$description: Optional CSS background image layered over the tooltip fill. Use none for a solid fill.

bg-start.$description: Legacy start color of the onmars v1 translucent tooltip image.
bg-start.$deprecated: Set the complete background image through the image token.

bg-end.$description: Legacy end color of the onmars v1 translucent tooltip image.
bg-end.$deprecated: Set the complete background image through the image token.

backdrop-blur.$description: backdrop blur used by the tooltip component card (MarsUI BACKGROUND_BLUR 24 = CSS 12px; none in onmars v2 and material3).
backdrop-blur.$deprecated: Use a complete filter value so a flat theme can turn compositing off.

backdrop-filter.$description: Complete backdrop filter behind the tooltip bubble.

fg.$description: color used by the tooltip component for foreground (MarsUI title row Text/high_em; onmars v2 sets the inverse tooltip ink).

font-size.$description: dimension used by the tooltip component for font size (MarsUI Heading_top style UI/Para/medium: body_1 13px).

font-weight.$description: font weight used by the tooltip component for font weight.

line-height.$description: dimension used by the tooltip component for line height (MarsUI line_height/para 20px).

shadow.$description: shadow used by the tooltip component for shadow (MarsUI Elevation/e4 on the master wrap).

show-delay.$description: duration used by the tooltip component for tooltip show delay.

hide-delay.$description: duration used by the tooltip component for tooltip hide delay.

bg.$description: Fill of the rich tooltip or rich popover.

bg-image.$description: Optional image layer over the rich surface fill.

backdrop-filter.$description: Complete backdrop filter of the rich surface.

fg.$description: Ink of the rich surface body text.

heading-fg.$description: Ink of the rich surface heading over the shared fill.

radius.$description: Corner radius of the rich surface.

shadow.$description: Raised elevation of the rich surface.

max-width.$description: Maximum inline size of the rich surface.

border-width.$description: Outline thickness of the rich surface.

border-color.$description: Outline ink of the rich surface.

padding-block.$description: Block-axis inset of the rich surface, before density scaling.

padding-inline.$description: Inline-axis inset of the rich surface, before density scaling.

font-size.$description: Body text size of the rich surface.

font-weight.$description: Body text weight of the rich surface.

line-height.$description: Body text line height of the rich surface.

heading-family.$description: Typeface of the rich surface heading.

heading-size.$description: Text size of the rich surface heading.

heading-weight.$description: Text weight of the rich surface heading.

heading-gap.$description: Distance between the rich heading and its body.

border-color.$description: --ki-tooltip-border-color under more contrast: an edge at 3:1 or more against the page.
